candidate.title: TruthInsightBench: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Automated Evaluation of Open-Ended Scientific Discovery Agents
candidate.abstract: Autonomous coding agents are increasingly proposed as AI-scientist systems that conduct analyses and write research reports, but executing a prescribed analysis is not the same as making a discovery. Existing benchmarks are configured for reproduction: tasks, data, and rubrics are built around a hidden target study, and recovery of its result is rewarded. We present TruthInsightBench, a benchmark configured for discovery. Its 40 blind tasks, drawn from 40 peer-reviewed studies across 10 scientific domains, expose only a neutral scientific objective and frozen data; source conclusions, expected values, and analysis paths are withheld, leaving the agent to determine what claim the data support. A fixed LLM-based judge scores the evidentiary maturity of an agent's own claims along six dimensions, operationalized as 29 artifact-grounded items, with automated, deterministic aggregation and no per-instance human grading, so evaluation can be repeated automatically as agents evolve. On one frozen base model, four coding agents form a narrow plateau (58.4-60.3 of 100) with no statistically reliable pairwise separation: they execute and document analyses competently, with comparatively strong evidence auditability and novelty, but largely lack the discriminating acts that establish a trustworthy claim (controls, robustness, falsifiability, and cross-dataset generalization). The bottleneck is scientific judgment rather than coding, and genuine discovery remains out of reach. TruthInsightBench makes this gap a measurable target; data and scoring code are at https://github.com/TruthInsight-stack/TruthInsightBench.
candidate.authors: Zhi-Bo Yang, Chen Zhang, Yue-Wei Zhang, Hao Wang

面向科学发现智能体的证据基准，批判性评测

extraction.method: 面向开放式科学发现的证据锚定自动评测基准
extraction.data: 40个盲任务，源自10个科学领域40篇同行评审研究
extraction.scenario: 开放式科学发现智能体评测
extraction.benchmark: TruthInsightBench；评测四个编码智能体（同一冻结基座模型）
extraction.results: 总分窄平台58.4–60.3/100，无统计可靠两两区分；证据可审计性与新颖性较强，控制、稳健性、可证伪性、跨数据集泛化缺失
extraction.limitations: 评测依赖LLM裁判；任务规模40个；未覆盖全部科学发现能力
extraction.summary: 论文区分“执行既定分析”与“开放式科学发现”，提出TruthInsightBench。基准含40个盲任务，来自10个领域40篇同行评审研究，仅给智能体中性科学目标与冻结数据，由固定LLM裁判按6维度29个证据锚定项自动评分。评测四个编码智能体发现总分仅58.4–60.3/100且无可靠区分，瓶颈在科学判断而非编码，真正的科学发现仍难实现。
